messages:
Emma (CSM): Hey team — kicking off the Nova onboarding thread. Main goals: get their API integration into Prod flows, confirm SSO/KMS, and a baseline perf/cost SLO. Proposed kickoff call: Wed Apr 1 10:00am PT. Who can make it?
Javier (Solutions Eng): I can. Need to know who from Nova will own infra questions (VPC, SSO, keys).
Nova Admin: Hi — I (Sam) will own infra. We need VPC peering + SSO via Okta. Also data residency in eu-west-1.
Li (Eng): Noted. For VPC peering we need their CIDR & contact for routing. For perf, what's their target p95 latency?
Sophia (Product): Success criteria suggestion: 1) End-to-end integration in staging with live traffic test by week 4; 2) p95 gen latency < 400ms for typical prompts, p99 < 800ms; 3) adoption metric: 20k tokens/day by month 2 and 50k by month 3; 4) no critical regressions on our eval suite.
Emma (CSM): Good list. I'll confirm dates. We're calling out adoption threshold for renewal risk — if <20% of expected usage by M+3, we'll flag for an enablement blitz.
Micah (Enablement): I can lead an enablement plan: 2x 60-min workshops (Dev onramp, Prompting & Eval), and a recorded runbook. Suggested times weeks 2 and 5.
Javier (Solutions Eng): Tech pre-reqs for Nova: API keys, example traffic pattern, seed prompts. Can Nova share a small sample dataset for eval?
Nova Admin: We can share redacted sample prompts and an early traffic estimate. Also need a key rotation schedule — our security team requires rotation every 30 days.
Li (Eng): Rotation every 30 days ok; we support short-lived tokens via our KMS integration. For initial testing, here's a minimal curl check they can run:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"open-llama-3b","input":"hello"}'
```
Emma (CSM): Action items so far: 1) Emma — confirm kickoff time + invite (owner: Emma) 2) Nova — provide CIDR, sample prompts, security requirements (owner: Nova Admin) 3) Li/Javier — prep staging cluster + small perf runbook (owner: Eng) 4) Micah — schedule enablement sessions & materials (owner: Micah) 5) Sophia — finalize success metrics and eval suite (owner: Product).
Javier (Solutions Eng): Also we should decide model variant for early tests (quantized vs full). Suggest start with quantized 7B to keep costs predictable, then scale.
Sophia (Product): Agreed. We'll use quantized 7B variant for pilot, aim to validate quality against our eval set before moving to 13B.
Emma (CSM): Risk note: If SSO or VPC delays push integration past week 6, that's a moderate renewal risk — we'll escalate to AM.
Nova Admin: Ok, I'll try to get the CIDR + Okta contact by EOD Monday.
Micah (Enablement): I'll draft the workshop outlines and post a calendar invite after kickoff.
OnboardBot: Reminder: onboarding docs are at https://redwood.ai/docs/onboarding — checklist template auto-created for Nova.
Emma (CSM): Perfect. If no objections I'll lock Wed Apr 1 10:00am PT for kickoff and send invites.
Nova Admin: Confirmed. See you then.
Javier (Solutions Eng): 👍 counting on staging creds being ready within 48h after kickoff.
Li (Eng): I'll allocate a small dedicated pool for the pilot (2 GPUs) — tagging infra ops separately.
Emma (CSM): Thanks all — I'll send the invite and the shared action items doc.
Micah (Enablement): Quick ask: which SDKs do they want? JS and Python?
Nova Admin: JS primarily, Python maybe later.
Emma (CSM): Noted. Closing thread for now — will reopen after kickoff with notes and timeline updates. :rocket:
